programme.title: New Zealand: Earth's Mythical Islands

programme.title: Blowing Up History

programme.title: Hitpig!

Director Michael Gracey's biopic, starring Jonno Davies, Steve Pemberton and Alison Steadman

programme.desc: [AD] A criminal mastermind hopes to seal his reputation as the greatest villain of them all by stealing the Moon. Animated comedy, with the voices of Steve Carell, Jason Segel, Russell Brand and Julie Andrews

programme.title: Despicable Me 2

Animated comedy sequel, with the voices of Steve Carell and Kristen Wiig

programme.title: Despicable Me 3
programme.desc: [AD] Dismissed from the Anti-Villain League after botching a mission, Gru sets off to meet his long-lost twin brother for one final criminal mission. Animated sequel, with the voices of Steve Carell, Kristen Wiig, Trey Parker and Miranda Cosgrove

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Two teenage brothers move with their mother to a coastal town in California, where the eldest falls in with a local biker gang. He soon discovers that his new friends are vampires and he is turning into one himself, forcing his younger brother to team up with a pair of heavily armed comic shop employees to battle the undead and save his soul. Comedy horror, starring Kiefer Sutherland, Jason Patric, Dianne Wiest, Corey Feldman and Corey Haim

programme.title: Heretic
programme.desc: Two young missionaries are forced to prove their faith when they knock on the wrong door and are greeted by the diabolical Mr Reed. Horror, starring Hugh Grant, Sophie Thatcher and Chloe East

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: [AD] In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson

programme.title: Jumanji: The Next Level
programme.desc: [AD] Players of Jumanji return, but as they attempt to rescue one of their own, they will have to brave parts unknown from arid deserts to snowy mountains, to escape the world's most dangerous game. Director Jake Kasdan's fantasy adventure sequel to his 2017 rebooted hit Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle, starring Dwayne Johnson, Karen Gillan, Kevin Hart and Jack Black

programme.title: Charlotte's Web
programme.desc: Youngster Fern tries to persuade her father to keep the runt of a litter when a sow gives birth to piglets on the family farm. Family drama, starring Dakota Fanning and featuring the voices of Julia Roberts, Dominic Scott Kay, Steve Buscemi and John Cleese

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
programme.desc: [AD] When a single mum and her two kids arrive in a small town, they begin to discover their connection to the original Ghostbusters and the secret legacy their grandfather Egon Spengler left behind. Supernatural comedy sequel, directed by Jason Reitman and starring Carrie Coon, Paul Rudd, Finn Wolfhard and Mckenna Grace, with cameo appearances by Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Ernie Hudson, Annie Potts and Sigourney Weaver

Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly

programme.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
programme.desc: A deformed bell-ringer living reclusively in a cathedral in the heart of medieval Paris is tempted out of seclusion when a gypsy festival arrives and captures his imagination. Disney animation, with the voices of Tom Hulce, Demi Moore and Kevin Kline

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: A rebellious teenager obtains a map leading to the planet where a notorious space pirate hid his treasure. Animated sci-fi adventure based on the plot of Treasure Island, with the voices of Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray and Emma Thompson

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom

programme.title: Green Lantern

Sci-fi adventure, starring Ryan Reynolds, Blake Lively, Peter Sarsgaard and Mark Strong

programme.title: Nobody 2

programme.title: The Bodyguard

Romantic thriller directed by Mick Jackson, starring Kevin Costner, Whitney Houston, Gary Kemp and Bill Cobbs

programme.desc: A retired army colonel has raised his three sons alone on their remote Montana ranch. Edward Zwick's period drama, starring Anthony Hopkins, Brad Pitt, Aidan Quinn, Julia Ormond and Henry Thomas

The wisecracking extraterrestrial enlists the duo's help in getting back to his spaceship, but they are soon pursued by government agents and unwittingly become kidnappers. Sci-fi comedy, starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost, with the voice of Seth Rogen

programme.sub-title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby

Forced to move back in with his mother, the downhearted driver turns to his estranged father for help rebuilding his shattered self-confidence. Comedy, starring Will Ferrell, John C Reilly and Sacha Baron Cohen

programme.sub-title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows

Action thriller sequel, starring Robert Downey Jr, Jude Law, Noomi Rapace and Jared Harris

The Coen brothers' Western based on Charles Portis' novel, with Jeff Bridges, Hailee Steinfeld, Matt Damon and Josh Brolin

Gabriele Muccino's fact-based drama, starring Will Smith alongside his son Jaden. With Thandiwe Newton, Brian Howe, James Karen, Dan Castellaneta and Kurt Fuller

Sci-fi adventure sequel, with William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, Ricardo Montalban and Kirstie Alley
